CYBRO TOKEN

The CYBRO token generates multiple values for its users. Apart from the traditional staking benefits, the CYBRO token gives its users bonuses for using the marketplace services and, in the same time, makes the use of this marketplace more profitable.

CYBRO tokens will allow you
  • Get discounted trading and lending fees depending on your Tier
  • Get APY based on the sum of Blast APY and the APY of the CYBRO token itself
  • Receive cashback in CYBRO by using the service
  • Receive higher yield by staking CYBRO.
  • Secure the investments against shortfalls with the CYBRO Insurance Program
